title: Actual condensed compositor data and elementary laws
statement: With the exact coefficient and geometric hypotheses of the condensed compositor realization statement, retain its actual Uniform, P, delta, systemTower, pinned RefinementIso and inverse, systemCompositor, five-arrow integralCompositor, U, comparison, transported archived condensedCompositor, openTrivial, ComparisonRefines and seven-clause Laws definitions, with all original public signatures and non-theorem bodies verbatim. The declarations formerly attached to the parent are moved together into an importable data module. Delta and the pinned refinement component remain proved isomorphisms; U remains constructible. proof.text: The refinementIso_exists auxiliary is now proved directly on the ordinary derived semilinear system category. For the actual completed coefficient object M of K, finiteTorConstructibleIntegral gives intrinsic constructibility of every finite scalar reduction and one common finite cohomological interval [a,b]. Restriction to constant scalars gives finite-model constructibility. The positive_stratification helper gives a positive global partition, including the empty scheme. The finite-model locality and geometric-stalk lemmas identify its strata with fixed-module lisse strata with finite stalks, hence fixed-module constructibility. The proved scalar_origin helper packages bounded etale descent as a ScalarEtaleOrigin for each finite reduction. The exact derived composition comparison identifies E_n followed by constant-diagram evaluation at any q with coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation at n; composing with reductionEvaluation transports those witnesses to E_n(R(M)). Apply StrictTower.gamma_isIso to this constant quotient-ring diagram. The equation gamma_evaluation, together with invertibility of evalR and evalJ, makes E_n of the actual semilinear gamma invertible. Evaluation at zero and the same exact composition comparison recover ordinary system evaluation. The detects clause of the semilinear derived section calculus proves that gamma itself is invertible. In the refinement square use c.i, identity_X, r.hom, d.i. systemRefinement is the paste of this gamma with the identity-proper unitor, a whiskering by d.g, the functor associator, and the proper compositor; all are invertible. Package asIso with its hom equality to obtain RefinementIso. This argument is for arbitrary CoefficientData A and needs no field-of-definition condition, no equality detection by evaluations, and no new assumed statement.

proof.text: Retain every original construction verbatim and the already proved refinement argument. The adjunct of beta satisfies reduction(delta) followed by the counit equals beta, by naturality and the adjunction triangle. Functoriality cancels the middle unit/counit pair in integralCompositor, giving its four-factor normal form in the faithful coefficient model. The comparison is the image of a rational isomorphism followed by the original Omega projection, which is invertible on constructible inputs. Paste the existing rational and Omega refinement squares to prove ComparisonRefines.
